domain: a live conceptual tension in Aeon
topic: a live conceptual tension in Aeon

primary.axis: separating the author's view of the debate from their view of the debate-about-the-debate

tension_system.interaction: the secondary tension complicates the primary at the passage's turn

family_realization.note: Masterful execution of 'The Autopsy.' Paragraph 1 stages consensus; paragraph 3 pivots to dissect *how* it formed ('attrition of opponents,' 'exhaustion of dissent'). The passage treats the debate-about-the-debate as the real object: 'A verdict reached by exhaustion records who tired first, not who was right.' Author cleanly separates the field's self-narrative from its actual machinery.

ending_behavior.note: Perfect 'Refused Synthesis.' Paragraph 4 explicitly declines the middle ('No. A conclusion certified by fatigue is not half-earned; it is uncertified'). The aperture 'holds': the sun-line reopens the object without resolving it. Reason given: inspection never happened, so the verdict stands unchecked, not vindicated.

voice_consistency.note: Prose maintains 'Analytic Miniaturist' throughout. 'Superstition wearing a lab coat,' 'watchmaking, not discovery,' 'tidy' (dismissive)—tiny distinctions abound. Avoids generic essay register. The tone stays caustic and precise, never inflated or hedging.

distractor_efficiency.note: Q1(A): stage_misattribution—strong readers might think the opening lists competing positions for fair weighing. Q2(C): stance_misread—reverses the actual objection, tempting those who skim. Q3(A): overqualification—plausible misread of ending as tilting toward free will. Q4(D): nec_suff_swap—traps readers who conflate 'proof' with 'multiple steps.' Q5(B): causal_inversion—reverses the attrition mechanism. Q6(A): overqualification—plausible but the ending withholds lean.

explanation_quality.note: Each elimination cites exact passage locations. Q3(B) points to 'bolder reading' of paragraph 2 as the rejected view. Q4(A) isolates the dependency: 'fatigue and evidence must disconnect.' Q5(A) mirrors paragraph 3 mechanism precisely. Q6(C) quotes the sun-line to show non-resolution. No generic 'not mentioned'; all grounded in text.

answers.reasoning: Opening stages consensus later exposed as fatigue-based, not genuine endorsement.
Author names it, credits adherents, calls it tidy/mistaking confidence for depth, refuses it.
Central claim: consensus reflects exhaustion, not truth, leaving question open.
Assumption: fatigue-based agreement has no evidential value about the actual matter.
Mirrors passage: dissenters leaving records attrition, not verification of the design.
Clock keeps time but uninspected; leaves free will question deliberately unresolved.
